Definition: a (clean) animal with fur, probably a species of antelope
BiblicalUsage: 1) a kind of leather, skin, or animal hide; 1a) perhaps the animal yielding the skin; 1a1) perhaps the badger or dugong, dolphin, or sheep, or a now extinct animal
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
